purpose covered: Purpose (header :1-4 and the four compositions :29-60) is read right: OpenVPN server with user auth, the VPN's own caching nameserver on the bridge allowed by the firewall, forwarding and NAT to the WAN. Checks test it as behaviour from a second machine: a PAM account connects, gets a pool address and the pushed DNS 198.51.100.1, resolves a real name recursively through that nameserver over stand-in default drops, reaches a WAN-side server that sees the masqueraded 203.0.113.50, and counters on 1301/202/203/205 attribute the flows; plus the class's own cipher (finding). Uncovered rows are true: client isolation, bridge/unit at boot, hairpin behaviour and compression are tested by openvpn_server's and firewall_addon_openvpn_server's sets, and network_vpn's defaults for reneg_sec 3600, cipher, client_isolation true equal openvpn_server's own defaults; compression is not passed by this class; parameter variants are untested (one params fixture), lifted_by ubuntu. The lab IPv6/-4 fixture is a lab-environment mutation declared in mutates, not part of the class.
